data.narrative:
DeepDrive is a Series B-stage transportation company that has raised $54.4M to date. The comparable universe in the transportation sector includes eight private companies (Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Arc Boats, and Parallel Systems among them) and no public peers, limiting the applicability of traditional public-market benchmarking.

The valuation analysis applies stage-progression methodology, which is applicable given DeepDrive's Series B status. Using total capital raised ($54.4M) as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $103M. A peer-median approach is not applicable here due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow transportation subsector—only three transportation peers exist in the database, none meeting the threshold of three datapoints within tightly defined filters. Attempting a broader cross-sector median would introduce material noise.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to a single applicable method, supports a median valuation of $103M, with a low-end scenario of $88M and a high-end of $119M. The primary uncertainty stems from the compressed comp set: without sufficient same-stage peers in transportation, the analysis relies heavily on stage-progression mechanics rather than market-based validation. Additional data on transportation-sector Series B precedents or revenue/unit economics would strengthen conviction in this range.
